datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on October 27, 2024
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 27, 2024, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20241027]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery (Sentinel-1 SAR) was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect water surfaces and map actual flood extent across Cagayan-Isabela, Oriental Mindoro, and Region 3 during typhoon-induced flooding on October 27, 2024. The processed data was delivered as georeferenced shapefiles and PNG maps representing observed inundation areas.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing using Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar to detect and map actual flood extent across three Philippine regions during the October 27, 2024 typhoon event.
